ev: But how many countries meet the ILO's guidelines on paternity leave? None, because no such guidelines exist.

ev: But much of the demand for a shift in approaches to childcare has come from women, who have started to conclude that they are victims as well as beneficiaries of generous maternity-leave policies.
16.why: Section C: đòi hỏi thay đổi lại đến từ chính phụ nữ — những người hưởng lợi từ chính sách nghỉ thai sản → nguồn áp lực bất ngờ → iv (Pressure for change from an unlikely source).

ev: But it turns out that long maternity breaks have unintended consequences.

ev: The problem is that dads tend not to take up the offer.

ev: To overcome these obstacles, some countries are giving fathers a firm nudge.

ev: The main reason for low take-up by fathers is financial

ev: But pressures related to culture also weigh heavily.

ev: And shared involvement by parents stands to improve women's careers, children's development and perhaps even dads' life satisfaction.
26.why: Tóm tắt: chia sẻ việc chăm con có thể hỗ trợ ___ của trẻ. Bài: cải thiện sự phát triển (development) của trẻ → development.
